Ein Raspberry Pi Pico W steuert deinen S: A Raspberry Pi Pico W controls your sit-stand desk over Wi-Fi – with a modern web interface, automatic sit/stand switching, motion detection via ultrasonic sensor and matching Android and Windows apps. Including Wi-Fi failover: if no connection can be made, the Pico automatically opens its own setup hotspot.
Vier Aktionen per Weboberfläche: Four actions via the web interface
Auf / Ab / Stehen / Sitzen steuern vier: Up / Down / Stand / Sit drive four GPIO outputs (e.g. for relays or a motor controller) right from the browser.
Zeitgesteuerter, automatischer Wechsel z: Timed, automatic switching between sitting and standing – configurable directly in the web interface.
Ein Grove Ultrasonic Ranger erkennt Posi: A Grove Ultrasonic Ranger detects position changes automatically (if the measured distance changes by more than a threshold set in the web interface) and activates the automatic mode.
Schlägt die Verbindung zum konfigurierte: If connecting to the configured Wi-Fi fails, the Pico automatically opens its own hotspot with a recovery page for new credentials – no reflashing needed.
Der Pico antwortet auf UDP-Broadcast-Anf: The Pico answers UDP broadcast requests on the local network – so the Android app finds it automatically, whether on your home Wi-Fi or in its own recovery hotspot.
Updates & Dateiverwaltung im Browser: Updates & file management in the browser

-Dateien) oder über die Dateiverwaltung: files) or browse, edit and delete them in the file manager – no cable needed.

Native App (C#/WPF) mit denselben Funkti: Native app (C#/WPF) with the same functions as the web interface – also with automatic device discovery.
Für die Bewegungserkennung wird ein Grov: Motion detection needs a Grove Ultrasonic Ranger; the rest (relays/motor control for up/down/stand/sit) depends on your own desk electronics and can be put on any GPIO pins.
Wichtig: Die VCC-Leitung gehört an 3V3 O: Important: the VCC line goes to 3V3 OUT, not to 5V/VBUS – the Pico W's GPIOs are not 5V tolerant.
Ein handelsübliches 4-Kanal-Relaismodul: A standard 4-channel relay module is enough – the four relay outputs are connected in parallel to the existing physical buttons of the desk controller (the relays bridge the respective button electrically instead of replacing it).
